exercises.name: Yoga Flow
exercises.instruction: Move through sun salutations, downward dog, pigeon pose, and warrior sequences with controlled breathing.
exercises.definition: Dynamic stretching sequence that improves flexibility, balance, and body awareness.
exercises.goal: Improve flexibility, promote recovery, and enhance mind-body connection through controlled breathing and movement
exercises.trainerNotes: Focus on breath-to-movement synchronization. Never force a stretch—find your edge and breathe into it. If any position causes pain, modify or skip. This is recovery work, not a competition.

flowSteps.name: Sun Salutations
detailedInstructions: Begin in Mountain Pose (Tadasana): Stand tall, feet together, arms at sides, weight evenly distributed
INHALE: Sweep arms overhead, slight backbend, gaze up (Urdhva Hastasana)
EXHALE: Hinge at hips, fold forward, hands to floor or shins (Uttanasana)
INHALE: Lift chest halfway, flat back, fingertips on shins or floor (Ardha Uttanasana)
EXHALE: Step or jump back to Plank, lower through Chaturanga (elbows tight to ribs)
INHALE: Press through hands, lift chest into Upward Dog (Urdhva Mukha Svanasana)
EXHALE: Lift hips, press back into Downward Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana) - hold 5 breaths
Step or jump feet to hands, INHALE lift halfway, EXHALE fold
INHALE: Rise to standing, arms overhead, EXHALE: hands to heart center
Repeat sequence 5 times, finding a smooth rhythm

flowSteps.name: Downward Dog to Pigeon Pose
flowSteps.cue: Square hips, fold forward, breathe into hip stretch
detailedInstructions: From Downward Dog, lift right leg high
Bring right knee forward behind right wrist
Right shin can be parallel to front of mat (more advanced) or angled back toward left hip (modification)
Extend left leg straight back, top of foot on floor
Square hips toward front of mat—use a block under right hip if needed
Walk hands forward, fold chest toward floor
Hold for 2 minutes, breathing deeply into the hip
Press back to Downward Dog, shake out legs, repeat on left side

flowSteps.name: Warrior I → Warrior II → Reverse Warrior
flowSteps.cue: Strong legs, open hips, flow with breath
detailedInstructions: WARRIOR I: Step right foot forward into lunge, back foot angled 45°, hips squared forward, arms overhead, gaze up. Hold 30s.
WARRIOR II: Open hips and arms to side, back foot turns to 90°, front knee over ankle, arms parallel to floor, gaze over front fingers. Hold 30s.
REVERSE WARRIOR: Keep legs as is, flip front palm up, reach back and up, back hand slides down back leg, side body opens. Hold 30s.
Flow back through Warrior II to Warrior I
Step back to Mountain Pose, repeat entire sequence on left side
Maintain steady ujjayi breath throughout

flowSteps.name: Cat-Cow
flowSteps.cue: Initiate movement from pelvis, articulate through entire spine
detailedInstructions: Start on hands and knees: wrists under shoulders, knees under hips
COW (Inhale): Tilt pelvis forward, drop belly, lift chest and gaze, shoulder blades draw together
CAT (Exhale): Tilt pelvis back, round spine toward ceiling, tuck chin, push floor away
Move slowly—feel each vertebra articulate
Let the breath initiate the movement, not the other way around
Continue for 10 full cycles

flowSteps.name: Child's Pose
detailedInstructions: From hands and knees, sit hips back toward heels
Knees can be together (more back stretch) or wide apart (more hip stretch)
Walk arms forward, forehead rests on floor (or on stacked hands)
Let shoulders melt down away from ears
Breathe into your lower back and sides of ribcage
This is complete rest—let go of all tension

flowSteps.name: Seated Forward Fold
flowSteps.cue: Hinge from hips, not from lower back
detailedInstructions: Sit with legs extended straight in front
Flex feet (toes point toward ceiling)
Inhale, lengthen spine, reach arms overhead
Exhale, hinge at hips (not waist), reach toward feet
Hold whatever you can reach: thighs, shins, ankles, or feet
Keep back as flat as possible—it's okay if knees bend slightly
Relax head and neck, breathe deeply

flowSteps.name: Savasana (Corpse Pose)
detailedInstructions: Lie flat on back, legs extended, feet fall open naturally
Arms at sides, palms facing up
Close eyes, release all muscular effort
Scan body for tension and consciously release it
Breathe naturally, observe without controlling
This is integration time—let the practice settle in

exercises.name: Foam Rolling
exercises.instruction: Roll slowly over quads, IT band, glutes, lats, and thoracic spine. Pause on tender spots for 30s.
exercises.definition: Self-myofascial release to reduce muscle tension and improve tissue quality.
exercises.goal: Release myofascial restrictions, improve tissue quality, reduce post-training soreness, and enhance recovery
exercises.trainerNotes: Roll slowly (about 1 inch per second). When you find a tender spot, pause and breathe into it for 30-60 seconds. Avoid rolling directly over joints or bones. Pain should be 'good pain' (6-7/10)—never excruciating. Stay hydrated after rolling.

flowSteps.name: Quads
flowSteps.cue: Roll slowly, rotate leg to hit all areas
detailedInstructions: Start face down with roller under front of thighs, just above knees
Support upper body on forearms, engage core to protect lower back
Roll slowly from just above knee to hip crease
Rotate leg inward to target inner quad (vastus medialis)
Rotate leg outward to target outer quad (vastus lateralis)
When you find a tender spot, pause and breathe for 30s
Spend 1 minute on each leg

flowSteps.name: IT Band
flowSteps.cue: Side-lying, control pressure with stacked legs
detailedInstructions: Lie on your side with roller under outer thigh, just below hip
Bottom leg straight, top leg can stack on bottom (more pressure) or step in front (less pressure)
Support yourself on bottom forearm
Roll from hip to just above knee (never roll over the knee joint)
This area is often very tender—start with less pressure
Pause on tender spots, breathe and relax into the discomfort
Switch sides after 1 minute

flowSteps.name: Glutes
flowSteps.cue: Cross ankle over knee for deeper release
detailedInstructions: Sit on the roller, hands behind you for support
Cross right ankle over left knee (figure-4 position)
Lean into right glute, finding tender spots
Make small movements or hold on tight spots
Target the piriformis by leaning deeper into the outer glute
Spend 30 seconds on each side

flowSteps.name: Hamstrings
flowSteps.cue: Rotate leg to target different areas
detailedInstructions: Sit on roller positioned under back of thighs
Hands behind you for support, lift hips off ground
Roll from just below glutes to just above back of knee
Rotate leg inward to target inner hamstrings
Rotate leg outward to target outer hamstrings (biceps femoris)
For more pressure, stack one leg on top of the other

flowSteps.name: Lats
detailedInstructions: Lie on your side with roller under armpit area
Extend bottom arm overhead, thumb pointing up
Roll from armpit down to mid-ribcage
Rotate slightly forward to target the lat more directly
Rotate slightly backward to target the teres major and rear delt
Keep core engaged, breathe through tender spots

flowSteps.name: Thoracic Spine
detailedInstructions: Sit on floor, place roller behind you at mid-back level
Lie back with roller across upper-mid back
Interlace hands behind head to support neck
Lift hips slightly off ground
Roll from mid-back to upper back (not into neck)
At tight spots, pause and extend back over the roller
Breathe deeply as you open the chest
Keep core engaged to protect lower back

exercises.name: Box Jumps
exercises.notes: Choose box height where you can land softly with control
exercises.instruction: Explosive vertical jump onto box with soft landing
exercises.definition: Plyometric exercise developing lower body power and rate of force development
executionCues: Setup: Stand arm's length from box, feet shoulder-width
Load: Quick countermovement, arms swing back, hinge at hips
Explode: Drive through floor, swing arms up, fully extend hips
Land: Soft landing on box, full foot contact, knees track over toes
Stand: Stand fully upright on box before stepping down
Reset: Step down (don't jump), walk back, full recovery between reps

exercises.name: Depth Jumps
exercises.notes: Use 12-24 inch box based on ability
exercises.instruction: Step off box, absorb landing, immediately explode into max vertical jump
exercises.definition: Advanced plyometric using stretch-shortening cycle to develop reactive strength and power
executionCues: Setup: Stand on edge of box (12-24 inches based on level)
Step Off: Step (don't jump) off box with one foot, land with both
Land: Absorb through ankles-knees-hips, ground contact <0.2 seconds
Explode: Immediately drive into max height vertical jump
Arms: Use aggressive arm swing to assist jump
Land Final: Soft landing, reset fully before next rep
Key: Minimize ground contact time - 'hot floor' mentality

exercises.name: Broad Jumps
exercises.instruction: Explosive horizontal jump with countermovement and soft landing
exercises.definition: Develops horizontal power transfer for athletic performance
executionCues: Setup: Feet hip-width, arms back, hinge at hips
Load: Quick countermovement, arms swing back
Explode: Drive arms forward and up, extend hips fully
Flight: Reach forward with arms, bring knees up
Land: Absorb through ankles-knees-hips, stick landing 2 seconds
